motivation: Actual fixed N2/M9 RandAugment reduced endpoint errors42->36(front),40->36(back), but NLL decreased only0.00290830439535017 and0.00196709402122126. Aggregate results known before this analysis; no new per-photo decomposition read yet.
question: Does the observed RandAugment accuracy gain conceal amplified confidence and NLL on persistent shared mistakes, or are the offsetting loss contributions elsewhere?
hypothesis: At fixed endpoint30, samples wrong under both weak and RA have positive mean(RA-weak) NLL and positive mean maximum-probability change, with the same directions on a group defined at epoch20 and evaluated at30. This is a conditional descriptive necessary prediction, not proof of a causal training mechanism.
primary_pair: front-weak vs front-ra, fixed first pair; not selected by new subgroup results
secondary_pair: back-weak vs back-ra, separately reported scope check, not independent seed replication and not a LoRA placement interaction test
data_boundary: Only20 already-used development NPZ caches (589 photos,37classes), existing train/dev manifest and source/result metadata. No images, weights, reserved confirmation, tests or new forward.
pipeline: Existing weak RRC scale[.8,1] ratio[.9,1.1] and HFlip. RA adds torchvision full14-operator N2 M9/31, bilinear fill[124,116,104]. No augmentation/controller/temperature change.
metrics: For every pair and prespecified epoch: original error and NLL, four exhaustive correctness groups both_correct/repaired/regressed/both_wrong, group count, signed NLL change and contribution divided by all589, true-class probability, maximum confidence and true-minus-best-other logit margin changes.
All-photo positive/negative NLL budgets and exact signed sum; interpret scores as losses/confidence, not calibration estimates.
Final repair/harm membership at fixed epochs5,10,20; do not choose best epoch.

Anchor groups defined from epoch20 correctness, applied unchanged at epoch30; also strict persistent-same-wrong-label subset where all4 epoch20/30 weak/RA argmax labels are the same and wrong. No assertion that these are true mislabeled photos.

For primary both_wrong30 and frozen both_wrong20->30 groups: mean changes, median, sign counts, leave-one-photo-out mean min/max for NLL and max confidence. No arbitrary effect-size significance/power gate.
All37 classes and all37x37 confusion edges at final endpoint reported, no target class selection or intervention based on development labels.
Initial epoch0 across arms is a negative control: logits/predictions/labels/IDs equal within preexisting1e-5 precision; signed contributions zero within tolerance.

directions.necessary_direction: both_wrong30 meanNLL>1e-12 and meanMaxConfidence>1e-12; independently report frozen20->30 signs and leave-one-photo-out influence
directions.strict_same_wrong_subset: Auxiliary check, not substitute primary if it fails

randomness.bootstrap: none; exact finite-cache accounting and leave-one-out sensitivity only
randomness.id_order: lexicographic source_id, stable tie argmax lowest class index

limits: Repeatedly inspected development data; exploratory diagnosis, not a new held-out confirmation.
Subgroups defined using predictions are outcome-conditioned; not causal effects or a deployable selector.
Two layouts share data and training seed, not independent repeats.
No ECE, calibration claim, temperature fitting, selected-class retraining, augmentation view damage or cross-seed generalization inferred.
Do not revive the closed placement-by-RA interaction.
Shared-noise training protocol not selected: actual local RA has no controller-label input and current clean-trained caches cannot identify shared-versus-independent-error training effects.
stop_conditions: Any hash, ID/label/prediction, nonfinite or decomposition identity failure stops interpretation, preserves failure.
If primary directional conjunction fails, reject this proposed explanation for primary cached pair; do not swap to another layout, epoch, group or metric to rescue it.
If temporal or leave-one-out directions are unstable, state limited persistence/influence; no claim of general stable mechanism.
Even if positive, no automatic training: cause still requires separate evidence, direct-prior discrimination, training-side perturbation and explicit resource plan.
Keep all negative outputs. No sealed reads, no ps retry, no OpenReview/IEEE verification bypass, no remote writes/uploads/credentials/fees or GPU.
